title: Add PHP's built-in web server (php -S with PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS) to the affected-systems SAPI table, from the StealMyBitcoin write-up
note: data files/affected.json lists mod_php, PHP-FPM, php-cgi, FrankenPHP, LiteSpeed and 'CLI/cron/queue (not web-serving)'. The Steal My Bitcoin challenge demonstrated full RCE via the php2shell upload-progress chain against the built-in server (php -S) with multiple workers behind nginx, on PHP 8.4.26 Alpine. A SAPI the primary advisories did not cover. Add a row once the write-up is captured (board correspondent-0005), sourced to it, risk 'demonstrated (CTF build)', with the note that it is not a production SAPI. Found by the correspondent 26 October 2026; covered defensively in articles/steal-my-bitcoin.
